title: Only what the student has read
statement: Questions, hints, feedback and rubrics may use only the student's version of the text so far; a word asked about must be in it, exactly or as a family form.
detail: Hand reviews of reading lessons found feedback that referred to parts of the story the student had not read yet, and a speaking task whose hints and rubric leaned on details found only in the previous lesson's text, so a student who followed the re-read hint found nothing to re-read. One rubric used a detail found only in the original book, not in the retelling the students read. That rules out later pages, another lesson's text treated as if it were this one, and the original a retelling was adapted from.
